provenance.construction: Symplectic multi-step move sequence on the stabilizer board entry codes/16-4-4-s.json ([[16,4,4]]): E-PEEL; peel qubit 5 with generator 1. Parent construction: Z4-invariant (quasi-cyclic) non-CSS stabilizer code: 16 qubits in 4 orbits of Z4 (qubit 4*b+g, b = orbit, g in Z4), 12 generators in 3 orbits of Z4 (each orbit = the 4 translates g -> g+t of one representative Pauli), every generator of weight <= 5. Found by a lazy SAT search over such codes (commutation encoded exactly; every nontrivial logical of weight < 4 found along the way is excluded togeth
provenance.notes: Pauli-weight witness from a 1000-trial RIS screen; distance is an upper bound.
